ANSWER: 3M's revenue was essentially flat to slightly down year-over-year on a comparable basis (continuing operations, excluding the spun-off Solventum/Health Care business): $24,610M (FY2023, recast) to $24,575M (FY2024), a decline of about -0.14% (not true "growth"). Note that the originally reported FY2023 figure ($32,681M) is not comparable due to the April 2024 Solventum spin-off, so a raw comparison would incorrectly show a ~24.8% decline.
